title: Sect Competition Commences
next_chapter_hook: The resonance grows increasingly intense in the depths of the secret realm—secrets hidden within, yet unveiled. The wheel of destiny has already begun to turn.

text.content: At the summit of the clustered mountains, clouds surge like a sea. An ancient stone gate stands between heaven and earth, its lintel carved with mottled runes that faintly emit a ghostly blue glow. At the secret realm's entrance, dense Spiritual Energy almost condenses into substance, forming a thin mist that coils around everyone's feet. Even an unremarkable wild grass by the roadside displays an abnormal verdant green due to the Spiritual Energy's nourishment.

Chen Ji stands at the edge of the crowd, his gaze sweeping across the surroundings, taking everything in. The forces of the three great Sects are clearly divided: Xuanwu Sect has the largest number, led by a burly young man, the legendary genius Han Lie, whose Spiritual Energy radiates overwhelming pressure. Holy Sect's contingent is smallest, but every individual emanates dangerous auras. Most eye-catching is the woman in the corner of the group, her face half-covered by purple silk, purple mist swirling around her—Ye Qing.

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul suddenly emerges, his voice urgent) At last, we've arrived. Remember, the Tianji Record has a great connection to this secret realm—its reactions, I cannot fully comprehend. But one thing is certain: the fortune here far exceeds your imagination.

text.content: Just then, a burning sensation suddenly spreads across Chen Ji's chest. He lowers his head and discovers that the Tianji Record Fragment beneath his collar is faintly glowing, its originally blurred patterns revealing themselves at an extremely slow pace. His heart stirs—Mo Xiansheng spoke truly, the Tianji Record resonates with this secret realm!

dialogue.content: (Han Lie coldly walks toward Chen Ji, a disdainful smile on his lips) Oh, isn't this the废物废物 servant from Tianqing Sect? I heard you were demoted to participate in the secret realm trial. Has Tianqing Sect truly run out of people?

text.content: Laughter erupts from the surrounding Xuanwu Sect disciples. Chen Ji keeps his head lowered, projecting a timid appearance, yet deep in his eyes flickers a cold glint. He glances at Han Lie from the corner of his vision—this person's Combat Power is indeed formidable, but he's simple-minded and easily provoked.

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing suddenly speaks, her voice clear and cold as ice) Waste? I actually think everyone who made it here alive is anything but simple. (She glances meaningfully at Chen Ji) Some people hide deeper than anyone.

text.content: Chen Ji raises an eyebrow slightly. This Demonic Path Saintess is sharp, actually speaking up for him? But this works well—let her draw attention while he continues to stay low-key. He subtly steps back half a pace, "timidly" murmuring: "Han-shixiong speaks truly..."

Han Lie snorts dismissively, clearly losing interest in Chen Ji's meek act. Just as he's about to turn and leave, a deep rumble echoes from the secret realm's entrance! Every eye snaps toward the stone gate—that ancient door sealed for ten thousand years is slowly creaking open!

At the same time, Chen Ji feels his chest burning with intensified heat. The Tianji Record's glow penetrates his collar, fully exposed before everyone! Onlookers react with surprise, some with undisguised greed. Han Lie stops in his tracks, his eyes flickering with unusual interest.

(Mo Xiansheng's voice becomes urgent) This is bad! The Tianji Record's aura is being drawn by the secret realm—now impossible to suppress! This light... will be sensed by everyone with keen perception!

Chen Ji's expression remains unchanged, yet turbulent waves churn within his heart. He slightly raises his head, gaze sweeping his surroundings—as expected, Han Lie fixes him with undisguised greed; Holy Sect's side also casts covetous glances; as for Ye Qing, a knowing smile curves her lips.

Since concealment is no longer possible, then I'll change strategies. A slight smile tugs at Chen Ji's lips, a plan already forming. He unhurriedly adjusts his collar, covering the Tianji Record's glow, then lifts his head, meeting Han Lie's gaze directly for the first time. His eyes are terrifyingly calm.

choice.prompt: With the Tianji Record exposed and various factions watching with predatory intent, Han Lie openly provocative—facing this situation, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Temporarily maintain a low profile, observe reactions from all sides, secretly arrange plans
choices.visible_cost: Waste time, might miss early opportunities
choices.visible_reward: Master more information, convenient for later arrangements
choices.risk_hint: Might be seen as weak and easily bullied

text.content: Chen Ji slightly lowers his eyes, his tone uncommonly calm: "Han-shixiong's strength is extraordinary, I am truly ashamed. Since the Tianji Record is fated with this secret realm, let it guide us all." He steps back half a pace, assuming a modest posture.

These words make Han Lie pause momentarily, then burst into laughter. He pats Chen Ji's shoulder: "Smart of you! Once inside the secret realm, if I'm in a good mood, perhaps I'll let you have some soup." Another round of laughter erupts from the surroundings.

choices.description: Reveal part of strength, make coveters retreat
choices.visible_cost: Expose some trump cards, might attract stronger enemies
choices.risk_hint: Draw focused attention from Han Lie and others

text.content: Chen Ji smiles indifferently, then suddenly raises his hand. A Spiritual Light shoots from his sleeve, passing three inches beside Han Lie's feet—the ground instantly cracks open a bottomless chasm!

The entire scene falls silent. Han Lie's face changes dramatically, he steps back half a pace, his eyes flickering with alarm. The surrounding Xuanwu Sect disciples who were laughing just moments ago are now deathly quiet—this strike's precise control and terrifying power is absolutely not something a废物 could achieve!

dialogue.content: (Han Lie forces composure) You... you've been hiding your strength?!

text.content: Chen Ji withdraws his hand, his expression calm: "Han-shixiong overpraises, these are merely minor self-defense techniques." He turns toward the secret realm entrance, leaving behind a crowd of stunned onlookers.

choices.description: Guide various factions to constrain each other, reap the benefits quietly
choices.visible_reward: Various factions wear each other down, convenient for fishing in troubled waters

text.content: Chen Ji "timidly" murmurs: "Han-shixiong may not know, Holy Sect over there also seems very interested in my... fragment." His eyes flicker, seemingly hinting at something.

Han Lie's gaze sharpens, following Chen Ji's gaze toward Holy Sect's direction. Indeed, several cold gazes are watching from that direction. He snorts: "Holy Sect's trash dares to compete with this young master for things?"

Chen Ji's lips curve slightly—let the snipe and clam fight, the fisherman benefits. He quietly steps back several paces, standing shoulder to shoulder with Ye Qing. Ye Qing glances at him sideways, appreciation flickering in her eyes: "Good methods."

The secret realm entrance fully opens, an ancient and desolate aura rushing toward everyone. Beyond the stone gate lies a deep passage, its walls inlaid with unknown crystals radiating a faint glow. Everyone at this moment holds their breath—ancient secret realm fortune stands right before them!

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing quietly approaches Chen Ji) That reaction of your Tianji Record, I sensed it too. This secret realm and the item on you... have some kind of connection.

text.content: Chen Ji nods slightly, just about to respond, when suddenly—a bizarre bell toll echoes from the depths of the secret realm! That sound is desolate and distant, as if traversing endless years. Everyone's face changes drastically—the power contained within that bell toll makes every soul tremble slightly.

The next instant, blinding white light sweeps from the depths of the secret realm, swallowing everyone! Chen Ji only feels the world spinning, wind howling in his ears. He instinctively grips the Tianji Record—that resonance reaches its peak at this moment!

When the white light fades, Chen Ji finds himself in a completely unfamiliar place. Gray mist surrounds him on all sides, beneath his feet lies an ancient altar. At the altar's center, a massive formation pattern slowly rotates. And within the mist's depths, faintly visible are other figures who were also transported here—all sent to the same place.

Illusion Trial Ground. The information transmitted by Mo Xiansheng flashes through Chen Ji's mind—this is the secret realm's first trial. All who entered will face trials here. And the burning sensation in his chest continues, the Tianji Record's patterns becoming ever clearer, as if something is awakening.
